title: Advanced Econometrics II

gradingBreakdown.component: Problem sets (4, may involve in-class presentations)

weeklyTopics: Resampling methods and asymptotic expansions (bootstrap, subsampling)
Topics in empirical process theory, functional central limit theorems
Quantile regression: endogeneity, longitudinal data, asymptotics of convex-process minimizers
Stationary and nonstationary time series theory: structural change, unit roots, structural breaks and trends
workloadNotes: Second course of the PhD second-year econometric theory field sequence (preceded by Econ 678); prepares students for the econometric theory field exam. Not open to master's students. 4 problem sets (20%) plus a take-home final exam (80%).
textbooks: van der Vaart, Asymptotic Statistics, Cambridge University Press, 1998
van der Vaart and Wellner, Weak Convergence and Empirical Processes, Springer, 1996
Koenker, Quantile Regression, Cambridge University Press, 2005
